points.statement: The work aims to handle varied degradations within a unified framework for practical use.
points.quote: All-in-one image restoration, which aims to address diverse degradations within a unified framework, is critical for practical applications.

points.statement: The proposed framework is guided by gradient-orientation descriptors to address complex degradation.
points.quote: To address this issue, we propose a novel all-in-one image restoration framework guided by Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG), named HOGformer.

points.statement: A dynamic attention mechanism uses discriminative gradient-orientation cues to adaptively model long-range spatial dependencies.
points.quote: By leveraging the degradation-discriminative capability of HOG descriptors, HOGformer employs a dynamic self-attention mechanism that adaptively attends to long-range spatial dependencies based on degradation-aware HOG cues.

points.statement: A guided convolution module improves sensitivity to degradations by capturing long-range similarities while preserving global structure.
points.quote: To enhance the degradation sensitivity of attention inputs, we design a HOG-guided local dynamic-range convolution module that captures long-range degradation similarities while maintaining awareness of global structural information.

points.statement: A feed-forward module increases model capacity for varied degradations via channel and spatial interactions.
points.quote: Furthermore, we propose a dynamic interaction feed-forward module, efficiently increasing the model capacity to adapt to different degradations through channel–spatial interactions.

points.statement: Gradient-orientation descriptors are observed to inherently characterize and distinguish different degradations.
points.quote: In this work, we observe that the Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) feature descriptor (Dalal and Triggs 2005) inherently characterizes and distinguishes different degradations.

points.statement: Its descriptive strength comes from gradient magnitude and orientation jointly encoding local intensity and directional structure.
points.quote: The descriptive power of HOG arises from its core components, gradient magnitude and orientation, which jointly encode local intensity and directional structure.

points.statement: Gradient properties provide discriminative cues sensitive to patterns specific to each degradation.
points.quote: These gradient properties offer discriminative cues that are sensitive to degradation-specific patterns.

points.statement: The proposed transformer handles unified restoration using gradient-orientation guidance.
points.quote: To this end, we propose a novel Histogram of Oriented Gradients Transformer, called HOGformer, for all-in-one image restoration.

points.statement: A core attention mechanism incorporates gradient-orientation descriptors into standard self-attention to improve restoration across varied degradations.
points.quote: The core innovation is a Dynamic HOG-aware Self-Attention (DHOGSA) mechanism that reformulates standard self-attention by incorporating HOG descriptors, significantly enhancing restoration performance across diverse degradations.

points.statement: The attention integrates descriptors at patch and pixel levels, adaptively emphasizing spatial regions according to perceived degradation.
points.quote: DHOGSA integrates patch-level and pixel-level HOG descriptors, adaptively emphasizing spatial regions based on perceptual degradation.

points.statement: The attention prioritizes key gradient orientations and magnitudes to yield more robust feature representation for unified restoration.
points.quote: This attention mechanism prioritizes critical gradient orientations and magnitudes, enabling more robust feature representation for all-in-one restoration.

points.statement: A local convolution with pixel-level descriptors captures degradation-related dependencies, while reshaping variants preserve global context and local detail.
points.quote: To capture degradation-related dependencies and enable efficient feature extraction in this attention mechanism, we propose a local dynamic-range convolution using pixel-level HOG descriptors, along with two HOG reshaping methods: bin-wise HOG reshaping (BHOGR) for global context and frequency-wise HOG reshaping (FHOGR) for local detail preservation.

points.statement: An efficient feed-forward module adapts to varied degradations by promoting global information exchange through shuffle and gating across spatial and channel dimensions.
points.quote: Besides, to make the feed-forward module in the transformer capable of adapting to various degradations, we propose an efficient Dynamic Interaction Feed-Forward (DIFF) module, which promotes global information exchange through shuffle and gated mechanisms across spatial and channel dimensions.

points.statement: A loss supervises gradient orientation and magnitude to preserve edges and structural integrity.
points.quote: Moreover, we propose a HOG loss that supervises gradient orientation and magnitude to preserve edge and structural integrity.

points.statement: The components let the unified model restore varied degraded images and perform well across weather and natural restoration tasks.
points.quote: These components enable HOGformer to effectively restore various degraded images in a unified model, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both adverse weather and natural image restoration tasks.
